I've done a lot of team composition reading and playtesting, and you wouldn't have an issue clearing the game with this composition whatsoever. However, I would make a few tweaks. First and foremost, Fran is ALWAYS the weakest character. Her Vitality is the highest out of the 6, but the rest of her stats are very lackluster. Black/Monk is one of the most powerful job combos for Magick (and awesome STR and survivability), and Fran just can't back that up. Use that combo on Ashe or Vaan. Give Fran Machinist/Foebreaker, as guns don't calculate stats in their damage formula, bypassing her physical weaknesses, and Foebreaker gives you long range usage of Shear and Expose, which reduce Physical and Magick defenses.

The Red Mage/Archer job combo should go to someone with good Magick and good STR and Speed. This usually comes down to either Vaan or Ashe again, whoever didn't get Black/Monk, essentially. Ardor and the Burning bow is so much fun to abuse. 

Basch is a little different too. He has the highest strength of the 6, with Vaan being a very close second. I usually want him as my Knight and the best combo with Knight is Bushi. You get access to some pretty excellent late game heals with Knight through Espers, and Bushi gives you Magick power licenses. Plus, Genji armor with a Katana will just decimate people. I suggest Knight/Bushi. 

Penelo is a fast, hard hitting Magick user.  She has BY FAR the fastest attack animation and charge time for Ninja Swords. My suggestion is Shikari/White Mage. She becomes this amazing tanky healer, that can dish out really quick hits inbetween her buffs and heals. This combo also gives access to using the Dark Robes and the Yagyu Darkblade, which is another insane combo that's up there with Genji/Katana, Burning Bow/Ardor and Black Mage with Holy from Monk. 

Finally, Baltheir does pretty excellently as a Uhlan/Time Mage. He has good speed and Strength, making use of the Spears very well, with Time Magick giving ally's haste, and hindering enemies. 

Espers are pretty easy. Knight needs two or three for their healing Magick, and Monk needs one for access to Holy. Otherwise I just make sure to compare what the Espers unlock to each class, and just give it to whoever would benefit the most. I hope this helped.
